objective: Measure whether an agent-directed crop inspection tool backed by an accepted frozen local top-k glyph classifier improves ambiguous-character decisions without weakening toolbelt6.1 ordering behavior.
hypothesis: The challenger will exercise inspect_glyph only on verifier-flagged or reader-disputed cells, preserve toolbelt6.1 reorder behavior, and improve or hold both deterministic sequence recall and blinded judged answer recovery against the frozen toolbelt6.1 baseline.

baseline.description: Accepted development comparison baseline: toolbelt6.1 seed on omp_toolbelt6, retaining v5 geometry plus deterministic order reconciliation and post-submit glyph adjudication.

challenger.design: Toolbelt6.1 behavior plus one essential inspect_glyph tool. The agent selects a geometry cell and literal candidate set, reads the crop, receives independent second-reader and top-k classifier evidence, and decides. Calls are append-only telemetry. The classifier cannot change output directly.

development_scope.downstream_probe: Blinded Gemini answer-recovery judge on outputs whose deterministic sequence metric can miss a materially better or worse reading.

smoke.two_layer_reorder_behavior: must remain active on the known trio

cost_guard.authorization: User explicitly requested autonomous execution of the bounded experiments and asked that the agent try the available capabilities where useful.

allowed_changes: library/evaluations/objects/ and library/evaluations/runs/ as immutable evaluation artifacts
non_goals: No production recipe, suite, case, gold, prompt, promotion, or station socket changes.
No direct classifier rewrite of the submitted transcription.
No broad glyph sweep or mandatory inspection of clean cells.
No qualification claim from this development-only suite.
stop_conditions: Stop before the full run if smoke completion, classifier staging, inspection-use, ordering, or cost gates fail.
Stop before the next paid dispatch if remaining budget is uncertain.
Treat failed or missing evidence as unknown; never convert it to zero or rewrite immutable run records.
